reports.description: Early November I become interested in crypto currency, mainly bitcoins. Therefore I opened and account with coinbase where I could purchase my crypto.  I could manage to have a quite good amount on my account. On January I contacted be capitalfunds regarding to high yields to forextradin mt4 by using their sophisticated platform. After explaining how arbitrage works and how I could use my bitcoin investment to make it grow. On discussing matters they referred to coinbase as being one of their companies. They said it would be much easier to explain me the procedure if I can use Anydesk they said to create an account I need a proof of ID. Once I deposited into the account  it showed my transaction plus $10000. Until this point looked everything legitimate. Nick Olsen(my broker) after one day he showed me my trades and how much I made. He said if I upgrade my account to 50.000 eur I could be VIP member with more benefits and exclusive trades. Nick told me to send more money into my account , which was possible only through coinbase of bitoins because via my credit card it was unsuccessful. I told to nick that my bank allowing me 300 pounds /day as he was calling me and giving me other ideals how to put money into my account. After this I started to realize that I have been scammed and started to research about capitalfunds. As I wanted to withdraw my money Nick called me and asked me why, said he cannot work with a man who cant control his spending, and assigned me to the withdraw team. By that time my balance showed 87.000EUR, after that I was again assigned back to Nick. Said I owed him money money  more than 10.000Eur I said I will not pay that or deduct it from my balance. Since that time I haven‚Äôt herad from them.
